description: The source file defines a SwiftUI view called SettingsTab, which provides a comprehensive user interface for managing app settings related to gateways, device features, and connection management in an iOS app. The file includes state management, UI components, user interactions, and logic for handling gateway connections, setup codes, feature toggles, and device info.

classes.name: FeatureHelp
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a feature help tooltip with an ID, title, and message.

methods.name: gatewayList
methods.description: Displays a list of available or all gateways, including options to connect or reconnect to last known gateways.

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: Creates a toggle switch with an info button for feature settings, along with change handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway based on the provided gateway object.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the last known gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a debug string summarizing various gateway states and logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Creates a UI element showing details for reconnecting to the last known gateway.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the textual manual port input with the current numeric port value.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Applies a setup code and tries to connect to the gateway based on its parameters.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a setup code, setting gateway host, port, token, and password accordingly.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL and updates gateway host and TLS setting.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the effective manual port based on user input and host address.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Checks reachability and validity of the gateway host and port before connecting.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to test reachability of a host and port.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Connects to a manually specified gateway host and port.

methods.name: setupStatusLine
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly status message about the current gateway setup or connection state.

methods.name: tailnetWarningText
methods.description: Returns a warning message if the gateway is on the tailnet but Tailscale is off.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Converts raw gateway status strings into user-friendly messages.

methods.name: hasTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the local device has an IPv4 address on the tailnet subnet.

methods.name: isTailnetHostOrIP
methods.description: Determines if a host string is a tailnet host or IPv4 address.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to the tailnet IPv4 range.

methods.name: parseHostPort
methods.description: Parses a host and port from an address string.

methods.name: httpURLString
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string from host and port components.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, disconnects gateways, and clears credentials and settings.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Generates detail lines about a discovered gateway, such as LAN IP, tailnet, and ports.
